title: Typing a decimal in a decision rule dropped the point
problem: Typing 0.5 key by key into a rule threshold saved 5, and 2.50 saved 250, because every keystroke was parsed as a number. A safety rule could silently get the wrong threshold.
fix: Values keep the typed text until it is complete. Typed decimals are stored exactly in conditions, outcomes and Try it.

title: A decision author could skip sign-off by lowering the risk tier
problem: While a version waited for sign-off, the author could lower the tier, withdraw, re-propose under the low tier, publish and raise the tier back, with nothing recorded.
fix: Lowering a tier needs sign-off under the current tier, the tier is locked while a version waits, and publish checks the higher of the tier at proposal and now.

title: A live version published at low risk was never reviewed after a tier raise
problem: A decision created at low, published and then raised to high kept a live version nobody had reviewed at high.
fix: Raising a tier opens a review of the version in force under the new tier, shown on the decision until it is signed.

title: One person could switch off a live high-risk decision
problem: Retire and archive acted at once at any tier, though lowering the tier needed sign-off.
fix: At High and Critical, retire, archive and restore need a reason and a second person's sign-off.

title: Decision outcomes were always saved as text
problem: Outcomes typed in the Rules view were stored as strings, so margin 4 came back as "4" and one decision could mix types.
fix: Outcomes have a type, values are checked against it and numeric text is stored as a number.

title: Retiring a decision version answered 500 after it succeeded
problem: The retire committed, then reading the row back failed, so the API and the UI reported an error.
fix: The row is refreshed before answering.

title: Deny from Needs you never sent its reason
problem: The Needs you inbox dropped the reason typed in the deny dialog, so every deny failed and told the user to write a reason.
fix: The reason is passed through, with a test that checks the request body.

title: An invited reviewer could not approve and was not told
problem: No role or invite option made someone a decision approver, and Approvals showed them enabled buttons that failed with internal permission names.
fix: Invites and Team can grant Can approve decisions, a built-in Decision reviewers set exists, and Approvals shows only what you can sign, in plain words.

title: Archiving a decision left its publish request open
problem: Reviewers were asked to approve versions of decisions that were already archived.
fix: Archiving withdraws every open request on the decision with a reason, and signing one afterwards is refused.

title: A cancelled agent run left its approval gate behind
problem: A run cancelled or timed out while waiting kept its human approval gate listed for up to an hour, and denying it did nothing for the live run.
fix: Gates are removed on every exit, stale gates drop off Approvals, and acting on a closed gate gets a plain message.

title: Permission changes took up to ten seconds to apply
problem: Each API worker cached permissions, so a fresh grant could still be refused on the next request.
fix: Grants, revokes and role changes clear the cache on every worker at once through Redis.

title: Withdrawal notifications were never saved
problem: The requester of a withdrawn approval was never told, because the notification was flushed and not committed.
fix: The notification is committed with the withdrawal.

title: Restoring a decision claimed its rules applied again when nothing was in force
problem: After restoring a decision whose only version was retired, the message said its published version answered again.
fix: Messages and list cards are built from the decision's real state, such as retired with nothing in force.

title: Members saw admin controls that failed after the click
problem: A Member on Team, decisions, Approvals or Risk and Controls saw invite, role and approve controls that were refused only when used.
fix: These pages are view only for Members, with a line on who can act and how to get the right.

title: Members could not export from Risk and Controls
problem: Export with hashes was refused for Members who were shown the button.
fix: Shown only to people who can view the audit log, with a note otherwise.

title: Wingman deny on one row denied every ticked row
problem: Denying a single approval on the Wingman desk also denied all other selected rows, with a canned reason.
fix: Deny acts on its own row and asks the desk user for a real reason.

title: Agents stacked a new decision draft on every proposal
problem: An agent proposing rule changes created a new version each time, leaving several drafts behind.
fix: An agent updates its own open draft, with an append-only change note.

title: Needs you showed 99+ to a brand-new member
problem: Watching reviews and failure alerts from everyone's agents counted for members who could not act on them.
fix: Members see only their own agents' reviews and their own runs' alerts.
